capabilities: Adjust text width, fonts, and line/paragraph/letter spacing from a popup
Change selection highlight color and apply reusable highlight markers
Add lined, grid, dotted, or notebook paper backgrounds to notes
Switch themes and save visual setups as presets
Add reading helpers like smooth scroll, progress bar, and reading ruler
extras: Manual installation only (community-directory submission is pending); desktop only, Obsidian 1.13.7+, mobile unvalidated; interface supports English and Ukrainian; runs locally with no external data transfer.
intentEvidence: Most of these controls existed somewhere in Obsidian already, or could be hacked together through themes and snippets.
motivation: The author built it for personal use because they wanted a faster way to tune the reading and writing feel without digging through themes, CSS snippets, and scattered settings.
problem: Obsidian's visual settings are scattered across themes, CSS snippets, and settings screens, making small comfort adjustments slow to apply.
summary: Compact popup toolkit that adjusts typography, note width, spacing, highlights, paper textures, themes, and reading aids from one panel.
